simulate_cycling_race: simulate a cycling team pursuit race with transition and pacing strategies
set_environmental_conditions: set temperature, barometric pressure, and relative humidity for the cycling simulation
configure_cyclist_attributes: set cyclist height, weight, and mean maximum power by cyclist identifier
update_air_density: update air density based on temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure
manage_team_positions: transition cyclist positions and find the current leader in the team pursuit
